title-titre-eng: Data analysis and reporting services for program evaluation
tenderDescription-descriptionAppelOffres: The Department requires research and data analysis services to support a program evaluation. The contractor shall analyze administrative datasets, produce a written report summarizing findings, and develop data visualizations. Deliverables must be provided in both official languages. The successful bidder must demonstrate experience with comparative analysis and policy analysis. The contract term is one year with two option years. Bids close on the closing date noted above.

title-titre-eng: Custom web application development and cloud migration
tenderDescription-descriptionAppelOffres: The contractor shall design and build a custom web application and migrate the existing database to a cloud platform. The system must support single sign-on, meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, and integrate with existing APIs. On-site presence in Ottawa is required three days per week. A secret security clearance is mandatory for all personnel. Technical architecture documentation must be delivered.

title-titre-eng: Supply and delivery of enterprise antivirus software licences
tenderDescription-descriptionAppelOffres: Supply of 5000 enterprise antivirus software licences with three years of maintenance. The vendor must supply and deliver licence keys. Installation support is not required.
The contractor shall supply and install modular office furniture at multiple sites. Field work and on-site assembly required.

title-titre-eng: Metadata classification and documentation for digital collections
tenderDescription-descriptionAppelOffres: The contractor shall review a digital collection, classify records using a controlled metadata schema, and produce documentation and a user guide. The work involves data extraction, categorization, and writing plain language descriptions. Experience with information management and knowledge synthesis is an asset. Deliverables are submitted electronically.
